construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written in this isolated build

input.feedback_item: Unique id, nonempty text and source; optional integer rating 1..5
input.optional: max_evidence: integer 1..20, default 3; theme_rules: 1..100 objects containing name, keywords, action
input.limits: At most 10000 feedback items, text at most 10000 characters; unknown fields rejected
input.theme_rules: Custom rules replace defaults. Names unique case-insensitively; uncategorized reserved. Keywords match whole words or phrases.

output.success: status=ok, schema_version, dataset_label, synthetic, summary, themes, assignments, method
output.theme: name, feedback_count, share_of_feedback, sentiment_counts, source_counts, priority_score, recommended_action, feedback_ids, evidence
output.error: status=error, error: diagnostic string; exit code 2

shared_schema.validation: One validate entry point used by analyze and CLI; strict JSON rejects duplicate fields and non-finite constants.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single stage: validated feedback becomes deterministic assignments, then evidence-backed ranked themes in the same response. No external handoff.
behavior: Default themes: usability, reliability, performance, pricing, support; configurable general-purpose rule vocabulary and actions.
Case-insensitive whitespace-normalized whole-word/phrase matching permits multiple themes; unmatched feedback remains uncategorized.
Ratings determine sentiment when supplied; otherwise unique lexicon word counts determine sentiment.
Rank by feedback_count + 2 * negative_count descending, then theme name; assignments and references sorted by id.
Evidence is verbatim, bounded by max_evidence, and negative-first; all matching ids remain available.
Empty feedback is valid; input order does not affect output; input is not mutated.
All fixture data is synthetic. CLI writes a single JSON object to stdout.

test_outcomes.cli: passed: one JSON object with status ok and five feedback assignments
